notes.title: v0.676 Blueprints
notes.content:
[b]NEW TAB - Blueprints[/b]
Blueprints can store, and reproduce identical copies of an existing board
[list]
[*] Create groups by dragging cursor along multiple tiles
[*] Sell or create blueprints for groups
[*] Group copy & paste
[*] Sharable blueprints
[*] New sound effects
[*] Multiple deletions that can occur at once
[/list]

notes.title: v0.675 Spawner Upgrades
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where some tabs were pixel based not percentage based, giving unexpected behaviors on larger monitors
[*] Spawners can be upgraded, giving additional points
[*] Camera movement tweaked to allow full visibility during upgrading
[*] Path History no longer shows as box to accommodate ultra-wide monitors
[*] Lightning symbol added in bottom hud to ensure power usage is clear
[*] Descriptions have been added to upgrade tab to prevent confusion
[*] Animation added to spawner upgrade
[*] Animation added to spawner information tabs
[*] Points can now be used simply by clicking the correct upgrade tab.
[*] New colors added higher level spawners
[*] Additional sound effects to improve immersion
[*] Fixed issue where the countdown of a spawner was not correctly displayed
[*] Increased spawner time by default to 30
[/list]
